venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Monday 8/10.** MOD MKZ. Net $781 vs $673 target (+16.0%). Food $123. 27 guests / $31.85 check avg. Comps $19.20 (Industry Love). MKZ covered opening bar; 3 meal deals to start and lots of early industry friends (Castellucci group, Savannah service-industry folks). Slow/steady till 10pm with a handful of campers at close — Casi Ciello friends popped in last. Auto Chlor tech got the BOH dishwasher back online right before open (MVP). Kitchen game-planning Saturday's event; needs KJ's pacing tips by Friday. 86'd: Woodford Rye, Grey Whale gin, Don Julio Añejo, Ocho repo, Crown Royal. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CC NSH — Monday 8/10.** MOD KE/JMS. Net $1,399 vs $1,168 target (+19.8%). Food $87. 40 guests / $35 check avg. Comps $34 (2.4%). Started strong with a ~15-person birthday party, plus regular Erin's book club (loved it, promised to return). Meal deals moving, business folks in, Red Door owner Chris on a date, and the usual date nights. Smooth kitchen. 86'd: Rosé, Pandra, Los Monteros. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 8/10.** AM MOD MJH; PM Carey & Rachel. Net $7,014.51 vs $6,655 target (+5.4%). DC/AM $978.60 / D&C PM $6,035.91. Food $1,624.60. 178 guests (Tock). Comps $303.67 (4.33%). Sleepy open with a nice pop that filled the room at the very end of service — all of RiNo felt like a ghost town. Slow night allowed for management/staff realignment conversations; team highly motivated. Maintenance: 2 power outages (Garden + Kitchen), details in maintenance channel. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 8/10.** MOD Kyler/Thomas. Net $4,739 vs $3,733 target (+26.9%). Food $260 / Beverage $4,479. 133 covers (1 large party, 9 solos, 2 investor cocktails) / $36 check avg. Comps $55.84. Filled up remarkably fast for a Monday despite rain — strong pressure through the first two turns with a neat turnover of crowds (happy-hour coworkers → date crowd → third-location crowd). 6 birthdays at the door, member Sophia Shan and Denver fans in. Top sellers: Rosalie, Paper Wasp, Eight Limb Daiquiri. Maintenance: upstairs bathroom sink board loose; mice heard in kitchen at EON; one of four speakers dead. No-show: Will Crager (2, 7:30pm), not charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 8/10.** MOD Mikey/Vic. Net $4,127 vs $4,228 target (-2.4%). Food $690 (all Marquee; Standing Room dark). 96 guests. Comps $125.90 (Mirate 22-top, NYC members, birthdays, anniversaries, first-timers, one walk-out). Decent early flow, then the Mirate/Tromba crew of 22 landed at 9:30 and kept the room full to the very end — Mirate gifted custom jean jackets to their staff, an emotional moment. Late close but speedy. Solid Monday, just short of target.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 8/10.** MOD Josh. Net $2,680.06 vs $3,651 target (-26.6%). Marquee bar sales $3,814.75; food $86. 33 guests / GCA $59.56. Comps n/a, voids $16. Extremely slow start — hot day then a thunderstorm kept the streets empty; a walk through the alley confirmed neighbors were equally dead. Around 10pm Jon & Jordan from Macallan brought a larger group ordering off the back bar, a nice revenue boost and good product depletion. Garden closed. Snacks only. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Humid and hot; evening rain and a big rainbow
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 8/10.** AM Sam & Shannon; PM James & Marcus. Net $3,551 vs $4,000 target (-11.2%). Municipal Bar AM $688 / PM $2,620; Sun Club $243; Hot Eye $0 (R&D'd new menu cocktails, no guests). Food $1,354. 72 guests (9 AM / 63 PM). Comps $220. Quiet Monday — mahjong friends back in the morning; Tanner called off and a slim evening crew (Chandler, Catie, Sierra) ran efficiently with a lightning-fast close. Sun Club had a great day until a 5:30 storm shut it down. Kitchen deep-cleaned line ovens; no lows/86s. No incidents.
